verdict.rationale: The official CrewAI CLI can create, train, run and manage crews and flows from the terminal, including scaffolding crew, flow and template projects. `crewai test` runs a crew for a set number of iterations and reports performance metrics, which suits an agent verifying its own build. The docs also ship a setup prompt that has coding agents check the CLI before editing code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive/headless behavior and machine-readable output, a clearly documented set of runnable example agents, and independent hands-on corroboration of terminal runs used for agent self-verification.
